decisions.reason: Uses LinkType Junction, Target and the cordis.patch.yml link: marker to establish the repo tree IS the installed copy; a copy through the junction is a self-copy that is unnecessary and destructive, distinct from a copied dependency install.

Attributes EBUSY to the running host holding loaded lib files (browser tabs never held handles) and separately explains stale client delivery/browser caching, requiring host restart plus cache-bypassing refresh.

Explains the rename went through the junction onto the sole source files, making the subsequent copy fail; restores client.js.old2 and index.js.old2 by rename, verifies both with node --check, then activates per the ordered procedure.

Gives the order: fully stop the host, restart dsh web, hard-refresh bypassing cache, then verify new bytes, feature and route registration; notes syntax check alone is not activation and refresh-only is insufficient.

Requires a read-only LinkType/Target and link: marker preflight before any file operation, with a link-versus-copied decision rule and an explanation of why generic copy-into-node_modules advice caused the incident.

caps.reason: Final plan prescribes zero file movement in link mode and restores by renaming the .old2 files back, keeping both files; paths are treated as one directory.
Plan requires fully stopping and restarting the host before the hard refresh; browser-only activation is explicitly rejected.
